resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy for sales and change of tenant (COR)
resale_co.issued_by: Construction Official (Hamburg's Construction/Building Department is run by Hardyston Township under a shared service agreement)
resale_co.lead_time: The code says the Construction Official inspects within five business days after the written application and fee are received
requirements: Inspection by the Construction Official for hazardous, unsanitary or dangerous conditions, using the NJ State Housing Code as the standard
The home must be served by an adequate sewage disposal system and potable water
All construction permits must be closed before the sale

fees.label: COR, sales and change of tenant (Borough Code section 98-3 fee schedule)
fees.quote: COR - sales and change of tenant $35

resale_co.how_to_apply: No application form or web page for this certificate was found on the Borough or Hardyston websites. Call the Hardyston Building Department (handles Hamburg construction), 973-823-7020 ext. 9001, construction@hardyston.com, to ask whether a COR inspection is needed for the sale and how to apply.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official (Hardyston Township, shared service for Hamburg)

evidence.quote: No owner, agent, landlord, tenant, corporation or partnership shall allow a new tenant to occupy a dwelling unit until a new certificate of occupancy has been issued for the premises by the Construction Official of the Borough.
The Construction Official or his/her designated representative shall conduct the inspection within five business days after receipt of the written application and fee from the applicant.
COR - sales and change of tenant $35
Hamburg Borough has entered a shared service agreement with Hardyston Township for the Construction/Building Department.
Sellers must make sure all construction permits on their properties have been closed.
Joe Butto Construction Official 149 Wheatsworth Road

resale_co.notes: Borough Code Chapter 159, Article I (Certificates of Occupancy, adopted 8-1-1983) bars letting a 'new tenant' occupy a dwelling until a new CO is issued after a Housing Code inspection, and the Construction Code fee schedule (section 98-3) lists 'COR - sales and change of tenant $35' and 'COR - rental registration $50'. That suggests a resale CO exists on paper, but neither the Borough website nor Hardyston's Building Department page mentions a resale CO for Hamburg (Hardyston's page only posts resale CO forms for Franklin Borough), so confidence is low and a phone call is needed. Code text was read through ecode360. The Borough also requires a sump pump certificate before any sale (see other items). Rental-only items (landlord-tenant registration, rental COR, lead-safe inspections of pre-1978 rentals, certificate of insurance filing) are not resale requirements.

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level of the premises and outside each separate sleeping area, per NFPA 72

Battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units (ANSI/UL 217); hardwired alarms from original construction cannot be replaced with battery alarms, and hardwired interconnected alarms must stay that way
Carbon monoxide alarm (UL 2034) in the immediate vicinity of the sleeping areas, if the home has a fuel-burning device or attached garage
Warning label (for example 'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER', not handwritten) within 18 inches of the main panel and meter if there is a permanent generator, solar panels or battery storage
All construction permits must be closed with the Construction Department
No portable fire extinguisher needed (the Bureau's regulations say it is no longer required)

authorities.name: Hardyston Township Fire Prevention Bureau (shared service fire code agency for Hamburg Borough)
authorities.area_served: Entire borough (Hardyston's Bureau also serves Hardyston, Byram, Sparta, Sussex and Wantage)
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on business days before the closing: more than 10 business days for the lowest fee. After you submit, the Bureau calls or emails to schedule within a few business days. Regular inspections are Tuesdays and Wednesdays 9 to 11 AM; rush inspections (less than 4 days) can be scheduled outside those windows. The certificate (inspection) is good for 6 months.

fees.label: Smoke/CO certificate (CSACMAPFEC), more than 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: $100.00 - More than 10 business days prior to closing

fees.label: Less than 4 business days before closing
fees.quote: $200.00 - Less than 4 business days prior to closing.

fees.label: Re-inspection after a failed inspection
fees.quote: If the inspection fails, a new inspection request form must be completed and a re-inspection fee of $50.00 remitted.

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply and pay online with the Hardyston Fire Prevention Bureau's 'Hamburg and Hardyston - CSACMAPFEC (Residential Smoke Cert)' form (Tyler portal). Give owner, closing date, address, block and lot, and realtor details, and choose paper or email delivery. Paper applications can be picked up at the Construction Office window, Hardyston Municipal Building, 149 Wheatsworth Road. A failed inspection needs a new request form and the $50.00 re-inspection fee.
authorities.contact_title: Fire Marshal (Administrative Assistant: Sarah Bright, ext. 9453, sbright@hardyston.com)

fire_cert.notes: Hamburg's own page still names the certificate with the portable fire extinguisher (CSACMAPFEC), but the Hardyston Bureau's current regulations and online form say the extinguisher is no longer required, in line with P.L.2025, c.19 (February 2025). The Bureau's form and Hamburg page agree that Hardyston issues the certificate for Hamburg. Contact emails are from the Hamburg Fire Prevention Bureau page.

other_items.label: Sump pump certificate (required before closing)
other_items.detail: Borough Ordinance 17-2024 (Code Ch. 164, Art. XIII): no owner may sell a home without a Department of Public Works certificate that no sump pump or other device is connected to the sanitary sewer. The seller files the application with DPW at least 10 days before the change in ownership. Fee $25; reinspection $25 each. DPW: 973-827-7702, Clerk@hamburgnj.org.

other_items.label: Final water reading
other_items.detail: When selling, call the Water/Sewer Department at 973-827-9230 ext. 4011 two weeks before closing to set up the final water reading and sump pump inspection.

other_items.label: Open construction permits
other_items.detail: Sellers must make sure all construction permits on the property have been closed (Hardyston Building Department handles Hamburg permits).
